attributes.has_name: Assess state machine formal verification feasibility
attributes.task_description: Evaluate if formal methods (model checking) can prove absence of deadlock in TigerDetectionApp state machine.

attributes.has_name: Verify object-list integrity and consumer checks
attributes.task_description: Inject malformed lengths, invalid coordinates, inconsistent identifiers, and stale timestamps. Verify that corrupted data does not reach warning outputs.

attributes.has_name: Verify lidar scan timeout and freshness handling
attributes.task_description: Inject acquisition stops, repeated sequence values, and expired timestamps. Verify rejection and safe-state signalling.
Identify shared supply, scheduling, memory, and transport faults that could affect lidar and infrared acquisition simultaneously; derive fault-detection and isolation tests.

attributes.has_name: Verify camera and lidar fault-status propagation
attributes.task_description: Inject invalid, stale, and contradictory status fields. Verify that publishers report faults and consumers reject failed channels within the specified response time.
Measure time from fault injection to safe state indication on HMI. Must complete within T_warning under worst-case scheduling.

attributes.has_name: Define camera acquisition fault notification mechanism
attributes.task_description: Define how CameraAcquisition signals fault conditions (frame loss, init failure, timing violation) to downstream consumers and system health manager. Specify DTC reporting and validity flag behavior.
Design test verifying alarm output stays within L_alarm_min to L_alarm_max after component aging (speaker degradation, amplifier drift).
Inject out-of-range and incorrectly scaled light and temperature data. Verify validation and fault reaction.

attributes.has_name: Define sensor fusion integration test scenarios
attributes.task_description: Inject frozen frames, malformed buffers, incorrect coordinate transforms, and timestamp/scheduling faults into Fusion. Verify data integrity, error propagation, and the specified timing response.

attributes.has_name: Verify tracking-feedback freshness and identity checks
attributes.task_description: Inject an expired track identifier and replayed tracking hints. Verify producer invalidation and consumer rejection across the feedback connection.

attributes.has_name: Verify separate RGB and infrared paths and capability propagation
attributes.task_description: Inject RGB-only and LWIR-only acquisition, calibration, timestamp and status faults. Verify that the unaffected modality is not relabeled, invalid/unknown/stale capability is not credited, and startup/degraded/recovery status reaches both UI and warning manager. Verify the documented detection-plus-response timing budget.
